articleTitle: Research on knowledge graph for quantification of relationship between enterprises and recognition of potential risks
abstract: It is always a complex and important research problem to find the correlation between enterprises and identify the potential risks of enterprises and grey list. In this paper, we adopted a method of knowledge graph building for graph neural network, including the quantification of association information among enterprises by constructing the knowledge graph of relations between enterprises. Based on the establishment of the knowledge graph among enterprises, we use the relationship algorithm to identify the potential risks of the target enterprises by taking the target enterprises as the starting point to find the associated enterprises in the knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of “One Belt, One Road” cooperation country Portrait index system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract: Since the “Belt and Road” initiative was proposed in 2013, the construction of the “Belt and Road” has continued to inject strong momentum into the development of China and countries along the route. With the increasing number of cooperating countries, the assessment and profiling of collaborating countries can help further strengthen the foundation of cooperation and promote win-win cooperation. In this paper, we design a multi-dimensional portrait index system of “One Belt, One Road” cooperation countries, which integrates data from international institutions and more than 220,000 global news reports on “One Belt, One Road” to build a portrait index system of each country. It quantifies “One Belt and One Road” cooperation countries in terms of investment environment index and public opinion trend index and provides new ideas for portraying the image of “One Belt and One Road” countries.

articleTitle: A Graph-Based Semi-Supervised Fraud Detection Framework
abstract: Credit card payment has become one of the most commonly used consumption methods in modern society, yet risks of fraud transactions using credit cards also increased. Numerous methods have been proposed for credit card fraud detection during past decades. However, most of the existing frameworks mainly focus on directly processing structured data. While they lack inner relations between features of raw descriptions for credit owners, this could lead to information deficiency. Therefore, we proposed a graph-based semi-supervised fraud detection framework. In this work, the structured dataset is translated to graph format through the sample similarity in order to improve the effect of label propagation on the graph. We further adopt the GraphSAGE algorithm which has been demonstrated to show excellent performance on node classification tasks. Experimental results on the real-world dataset show that our graph-based model can outperform state-of-the-art baselines. We argue that our model could be extended to other classification tasks using structured data.

articleTitle: Using Supervised Machine Learning to Detect High-Skill Mutual Fund Managers
abstract: This paper conducts a supervised machine learning algorithm under the guidance of an existing costly signaling model, and shows that traditional machine learning techniques can be applied successfully in the asset management industry combined with appropriate economic theory. This paper shows that the supervised machine learning algorithm can separate high- and low-skill corporate bond mutual fund managers by reading risk-related information in funds' prospectus. Other empirical evidence such as risk taking profile of fund managers shows that the results from the supervised machine learning algorithm are consistent with the model predictions.

articleTitle: The simulation of CSI 300 Index Option Pricing Based on Black-Scholes Model
abstract: The paper goes on a simulation pricing study for Chinese CSI 300 Index based on the Black-Scholes option pricing model, according to pricing model we get that the price of a three-month CSI 300 Index call option, whose strike price is 4006.44, is approximately 33.46 at November 30, 2017, and the price of put option is zero. And the simulation results show that given historical data, an option price could reflect the future price trend of underlying asset in some degree, and CIS 300 Index have quite large probability of going up.

articleTitle: Integrating knowledge graph into deep neural network-based recommender system
abstract: In recent years, the integration of knowledge graphs into explainable recommendation systems has attracted more and more attention. And the relations existing in the knowledge graph can provide much information while exploring the users' preference. However, existing approaches only consider the single relation between entities, so they lack accuracy and practicality for multiple relations. In addition, previous work cannot capture the semantics of all paths. Towards this end, we propose three significant modelling advances: (1) besides the relations, we also learn to jointly reasoning on the entities and entity-types; (2) we use elaborate pooling layer to incorporate the paths between entities; (3) we take a better way to extract paths' semantic representations. The experimental study demonstrates the superiority of our method compared with the state-of-the-art ones.

articleTitle: Research on the Co-movement of Bond and Stock Market
abstract: This paper establishes the AR-GARCH-T Copula model to study the Co-movement between my country's bond market and stock market. It is found that the level of linkage between the two cities in my country has extremely time-varying characteristics. At the same time, the liquidity factor of the financial market significantly affects the level of linkage between the two cities. After market liquidity becomes tighter, the correlation coefficient between the two cities will rise significantly. This research has important reference value for investment portfolio construction, financial market supervision and risk control.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of fairness tendency on inter group relationship in urban integration
abstract: Due to the different social and economic status, urban residents have a higher tendency of social dominance, which produces some stereotype on migrant workers, thus affecting the inter group relationship between them. This paper starts from the opposite of social dominance tendency - fairness tendency, analyzes its relationship with stereotype, and assumes the relationship among fairness tendency, group entity and others' stereotype. Through empirical analysis, it is proved that fairness tendency has a significant positive impact on socioeconomic status of one of the four dimensions of others' stereotype, and group entity can be used as the intermediary variable between social dominance and socio-economic status. Based on these conclusions, this paper puts forward some suggestions to improve the relationship between urban residents and migrant workers, which have guiding significance for the realization of inter group harmony.

articleTitle: Study on stylized stock market volatility based on asymmetric GARCH model in the main area of BRI region
abstract: Volatility is a crucial financial issue in stock exchange markets. Numerous pieces of research have been studied in financial time series for understanding the volatility clustering. TGARCH model and EGARCH model are adopted to characterise the fluctuation on the major volatile stock market including FTSE MIB, KOSPI, IMOEX and JCI in the period from January 2010 to December 2019 accordingly conducting test series of volatility styles such as unit root analysis breaks, tests for autocorrelation and ARCH effects. The identified findings which both short-term and long-term volatility are persistent. The asymmetric GARCH models show the impact of negative news on volatility that tends to affect more an asymmetry on daily volatility returns than positive news. Besides, EGARCH is indicated more accurate model for measuring than the other and KOSPI is the most sensitive to bad news contrasting with FTSE MIB.

articleTitle: The network environmental and socioeconomic efficiency analysis of watershed ecological compensation
abstract: Rapid economic growth in China has placed an increasing pressure on the ecological conditions. As one of the effective measures, ecological compensation has been playing an important role that has received more and more attention. Being a typical case of ecological compensation, Xin'an river basin is the first transboundary pilot which could serve as the demonstrating example on watershed ecological compensation. With Data development Analysis (DEA) used as the method and network model selected as the model, this paper measures the environmental efficiency, socioeconomic efficiency, as well as the overall efficiency of this pilot. The results indicate an approximately opposite relationship between its environmental efficiency and socioeconomic efficiency. In this way, this paper connects environmental, economic and social benefits, so as to provide a reference for seeking the balanceable path of integrating economic and social development with the construction of ecological civilization.

articleTitle: Research on Monetary Assessment of Ship Oil Spill Damage with Machine Learning Methods
abstract: Based on ship oil spill accidents in recent decades, this work built a rapid monetary assessment model for damage caused by ship oil spill accident. By analyzing the sample data, five types of indicators (oil spill volume, oil film area, oil product proportion, shoreline length, shoreline type) have been selected to establish an index system. The assessment model is established with machine learning method for a quick evaluation and estimation of compensation amount of the oil spill damage. The results obtained with BP artificial neural network, RBF artificial neural network and Support Vector Machine simulation model are compared and analyzed. At the same time, multiple linear regression analysis is used to analyze the influence degree of the compensation amount of each index. Finally, the most practical model and influencing factors are identified to support the realworld cases in the future.

articleTitle: Antirust of Digital Economy : Technology Spillover and Dynamic Market Regulation
abstract: The development of the digital economy in recent years has brought enormous challenges and controversy to antimonopoly and competition policies. Among them, the “big debate” surrounding the antitrust of digital economy in the United States and China is the most striking. The “big debate” was initiated by the criticism on the tech giants and the current anti-monopoly system. It spurred comprehensive and systematic discussion and rethinking about the anti-monopoly of the new economy. This article reviews the “big debate” from anti-monopoly. We also analyze and do retrospective study on the ideas of the digital economy anti-monopoly. This paper argues that some New ideas does not possess the conditions to become the mainstream anti- monopoly school in the digital economy, and the debate on liberalism and interventionism behind this debate will continue. However, this “big debate” along with the economic thinking behind the New ideas about digital economy has brought valuable thoughts and inspirations to the development of anti-monopoly and the progress of the entire anti-monopoly entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: Equilibrium analysis in dual-channel environment with dominant e-tailers
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of the manufacturer and the e-tailer under the influence of a vertical variable (cross-channel effect) and a horizontal variable (e-tailers` competition) in the dominant e-tailer structure. A game theoretic pricing model of one common manufacturer and two e-tailers is built. Then, the corresponding equilibrium solution is derived from the model. Then, a comparison between the equilibrium results of the dominant e-tailer power structure and the dominant manufacturer power structure is performed. It is found that in the dominant e-tailer power structure, the equilibrium exists only when the cross-channel effect is positive and the competition parameter is not large.

articleTitle: The effect of regulation on programming strategies of radio broadcasting
abstract: In this paper, I present an empirical analysis of product differentiation using a dataset on radio broadcasting in major radio stations in France from year 2013 to 2016. From 1994, French government stipulates that a certain proportion of music in French, at least 40 percent, should play on radio stations. The regulation was introduced as part of efforts to protect and promote cultural diversity. Radio stations argued that the regulation imposed a constraint upon the programming decision and forced them to branch out and play less well-aired content. The regulation has an effect on the local ratio broadcasting, giving rise to changes affecting stations' programming decisions. I compute a measure of product similarity index called cosine similarity, which allow me to estimate program differentiation in a multi-characteristics space. The results suggest that stations complying with the regulation are more likely to broadcast similar program contents than noncomplying stations.

articleTitle: Decision making and coordination of dual channel supply chain based on goodwill recovery difference
abstract: The new Internet + recovery mode is no longer limited by time and space, effectively solving the problems of mobile phone pricing and user privacy leakage, and improves the enthusiasm of users to recycle. the paper introduces the service effort degree variable of channel providers, establishes the recycling utility function based on the consumer preference theory and Hotelling model, and then determines the recycling function; and constructs the competition cooperation recycling model between the third-party online recycling platform and channel providers. The results show that: (1) the third-party platform will choose the channel providers with strong strength and high recovery goodwill as the partners to expand offline recovery channels. (2) When the third-party platform is dominant and both parties have equal status, users choose more offline recycling channels. (3) no matter what the power structure of the supply chain is, the effort of the channel provider decreases with the increase of its own recycling goodwill.

articleTitle: Value at Risk Performance in BRICS countries
abstract: This study aims to verify the actuary of the VaR model to find out whether the VaR model can provide accurate risk measurement results for market risk, especially the stock exchange market of BRICS, particularly historical VaR and delta normal VaR model. We used the POF test and independence test of Kupiec - Christoffersen (1998), which is commonly used to determine the accuracy of VaR for the backtesting VaR model. The result of the risk measurement performance for historical VaR provides a reasonably reliable VaR over delta normal by using Kupiec's POF-test for VaR model accuracy. The independence test of Christoffersen(1998) indicates exceptions to dependency (failures) in the historical VaR and delta normal VaR model.

articleTitle: Research on Systemic Risk Measurement Based on Factor Analysis
abstract: In this paper, related indicators in the stock market, bond market, money market, foreign exchange market, financial institution, and macroeconomic indicators are selected. Using China's macro and microeconomic data from 2007 to 2020, it adopts the factor analysis method to construct financial stress index to measure systemic risk. The empirical analysis found that Chinese Financial Stress Index has shown changes in phases. After four large peak fluctuations, the trend has fallen in the low-risk range in recent years. The Chinese Financial Stress Index constructed based on the factor analysis method can better describe China's systemic risk status in recent years and has a strong reference significance for the identification and prevention of systemic risks.

articleTitle: Research on the relevance of urban development
abstract: The evaluation of comprehensive development level of one region has always been a complicated problem. On the basis of it, to investigate the influencing factors and correlation effects of regional development is also a hot spot. This paper studied the development index of some Chinese cities, adopted the planning method of integer programming and obtained the representative cities and portfolio structure of the development index to explore the relevance of urban development in China.

articleTitle: Rent-seeking, marketization and real earnings management
abstract: The rent-seeking behavior of enterprises in economic society undermines the fairness and equity of the market order, and has a negative impact on the stable economic development. The study found that top management team has the motivation to manipulate earnings because of rent-seeking under the background of the improving marketization, which reduces the quality of financial reports. To reduce political costs, rent-seeking enterprises are more likely to reduce earnings after distinguishing the direction of real earning management. Further research found that the real earnings management caused by rent-seeking is more significant in the areas with high degree of marketization, but the motivation of reducing earnings is weakened.

articleTitle: The application prospect of knowledge graph in IPO approvals
abstract: On March 1, 2020, China began to implement the newly revised Securities Law, which clarified the full implementation of the registration system. The IPO registration system with information disclosure as the core is an important reform of China's capital market. How to effectively urge issuers and securities intermediaries to disclose information in accordance with laws and regulations and ensure the high quality of information disclosure is the focus and difficulty of registration system supervision. Knowledge graph can fully explore the correlation between entities, and it has a high application value in the formalized approval of IPO information disclosure.

articleTitle: A Two-Phase Method for Solving the Hub Location and Routing Problem
abstract: In this paper, we deal with the hub location and routing problem (HLRP) for long distance less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation network in the context of logistics markets, where suppliers and customers are mainly scattered in urban areas. It couples with three problems: positioning the hubs among candidates; assigning customers to hubs; routing the pickups and deliveries for the customers assigned to each hub. A two-phase method was proposed and the mixed-integer linear programing models are experimented on instances based on AP data set. The results are compared in terms of computing performance and optimality. Extensive results demonstrate that using our methods optimal solutions could be found for each phase within quick computing times.

articleTitle: Measure of China's environmental economic efficiency
abstract: The global CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions topic has attracted many scholars due to the cause of many environmental issues. Many research works showed the relationships between CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions, energy consumption, and economic components. An integrated approach between an extended Kaya identity based the logarithmic-mean Divisia index (LMDI) and a data envelopment analysis (DEA) was applied in order to evaluate the environmental economic effectiveness. DEA can compare efficiencies of units in a system; moreover, an LMDI can express the corresponding contributions between inputs and outputs and avoid the hypersensitivity of the inputs and outputs selection process in DEA. The variables of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions, energy consumption, and economic components of China from 1990 to 2016 were transformed into various factors for this efficiency evaluation. The results from the integrated approach between LMDI and DEA performed better fitted than the ordinary DEA. It seems likely that this approach can produce better correlation between the input and output variables, and also it can return less variance in the models. These possibly help to reduce a gap in the hypersensitivity issue.

articleTitle: A System of Visualizing Business Chart Using Text Mining Techniques
abstract: The selection of business charts based on data attributes and the purpose of visualization is an important consideration in improving accessibility of data interpretation and decision-making. However, the data visualization tools currently in usage are limited to the provision of numerous charts, and the selection of semantical-sensitive charts still falls back on personal experience and subjectivity. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to recommend proposed methods for improving the accuracy and efficiency of business charts in data usage by developing rules in accordance with data attributes and the purpose of visualization without specific knowledge required on the usage of business charts. For achieving the purpose, the definition and use cases of business charts were collected through web crawling, and keywords characterized each business chart were extracted through TF -IDF analysis. Subsequently, keywords matrix was created according to the associations of these extracted keywords with each business chart and used as recommendation rules.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Comprehensive Influence Evaluation of Government Affair Weibo and WeChat Official Account Using Analytic Hierarchy Process and Principal Component Analysis
abstract: Combined with the status quo of official account, this paper makes an empirical analysis of the comprehensive influence of government affair Weibo and WeChat official account by using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and principal component analysis (PCA). This analysis based on the data of government affair Weibo, WeChat official account and experts' questionnaire of 500 departments across China in 2015. The results show that although the basic ideas of the two methods are different, PCA analyzes the indicator data on the basis of explaining the variance contribution rate and gives more weight to the data with large variance contribution rate, which is highly objective; AHP gives more weight to the data with large variance contribution rate based on expert experience, which is highly subjective. After all, the results of PCA and AHP are consistent.

articleTitle: Why Did Polls or OPOs Get Forecast Wrong? Perceived Bias and Inference of Bias Impact
abstract: The failed election forecasts based on polls and Online Public Opinions(OPOs) cast doubts on the predictability of big data. In this paper, we try to examine whether polls and OPOs reveal vote preferences. Taking the 2016 US presidential election as an example, we adopt the dynamic linear models to trace two candidates' popular votes by fusing measurements from social media, news, prediction market, and polls. The interesting findings we obtained are as follows. First, with the estimations of basic dynamic linear model, we find that both the polls and OPOs are subject to measurement bias. Second, to characterize the bias, we add a time-varying parameter into the basic dynamic linear model. Via Markov Chain Monte Carlo(MCMC) estimations, we find that although polls and news failed to reflect the victory of Donald Trump, they did reflect candidates' popularity nationwide. Compared with polls and news, OPOs have larger deviations in revealing candidates' national popularity, but they are closer to the electoral vote outcome. Third, we find that there are patterns in the same type of measurement bias, no matter in direction or magnitude. The above three findings highlight the necessity of fusion method using multi-source heterogeneous data to make election forecasts. The fusion is expected to cancel out different types of measurement bias. The findings also indicate that both the polls and OPOs reveal the public opinions although the measurement bias exists. It is useful to adjust measurements extracted from polls and OPOs for specific forecast models.

articleTitle: A Nonparametric High-Dimensional Mean-Vector Test Method Based On Marginal Sign
abstract: The test of the mean vector is one of the most important kinds of problem in multivariate statistics. The classic Hotelling T2 Test has a good performance. Whlie the dimension of the data is close to the sample size or even larger than the sample size, the classic Hotelling T2 Test loses its advantages due to the singularity of the sample covariance matrix. Faced with such a problem, this paper proposes a non-parametric High-Dimensional test method based on Marginal Sign. After transformation, it can be expressed as the sum of the sign test statistics of each dimension, causing it easier to infer the progressive distribution of the test statistics when the dimension approaches infinity. After giving the test statistic, we conduct the numerical experiment in this paper to try to compare the advantages and disadvantages of the new method with the existing methods. With the comparison, the method proposed in this paper has performed well both on the normal data and the the non-normal data. The non-parametric method proposed in this paper reflects its non-distribution characteristics, which can better control the probability of the II error.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Volatility and External Event Analysis of Crude Oil Price Prediction
abstract: To study the characteristics of crude oil price fluctuations and analyze the impacts of external events, this paper first employs the CEEMD method to decompose the crude oil historical prices into different components and extracts a market fluctuation, a shock from extreme events, and a long-term trend. And we find that when determining the crude oil prices, the shock from extreme events has become the most important factor. Then we combine the ICSS test with the Chow test to get the structural breaks and analyze extreme event impacts. Finally, considering the interaction between external event impacts and crude oil prices, we establish the models based on VAR, SVM, and structural breaks to predict the crude oil prices, finding that the CEEMD- VAR-SVM model with structural breaks performs best compared to other models we establish.

articleTitle: Agricultural soil erosion and conservaiton in China
abstract: Along with the population increase and food security in the past decades, intensified agricultural production has been induced in China and many other parts of the world. However, intensive agriculture has, in turn, resulted in many severe environmental problems. As one of the major concerns, soil erosion by cropland cultivation has broad and profound influences on both no-site and off-site effects from the perspectives of either environment conservation, economic damage, or social development. The resulted damages include negative effects on long-term sustainability of food production and its resulted economic loss, as well as human health and agro-ecosystem functions. For better conservation of soil erosion, this paper gives the analysis of the mechanism of soil erosion, based on which the situation of soil erosion and the current conservation of it in China is further analyzed.

articleTitle: Shopping guide investment in new retail: A newsvendor problem with capital constranit
abstract: This paper examines effect of shopping guide investment from new retail perspective with capital constraint retailer sourcing from trade credit. Apart from existing stochastic demand, there is efficacious demand stimulated by shopping guide investment in the market. This stimulating demand mainly depends on sale price and stochastic expected value of consumers. We consider effect of sale price and capital constraint on supply chain operational decision, like order decision and shopping guide investment strategy, etc. In our model, sale price has income effect and demand effect conversely on retailer's decision. When sale price is in a low level, income effect is dominant, making retailer improve inventory and shopping guide investment dramatically. On high sale price condition, demand effect is obvious, making order quantity keep robust and leading to decreasing of shopping guide investment. Besides, sale price has positive impact on wholesale price and can improve profit of retailer and manufacturer. We consider in influences of initial capital. With increase of initial capital, order quantity decreases and investment of shopping guide increases. This is risk shifting mechanism for manufacturer to improve wholesale price for response to retailer's bankruptcy risk. We find there exists shopping guide benefits to supply chain when retailer is extremely capital constraint. Numerical examples are given to demonstrate the impact of sale price and initial capital on optimal decision.
